manifests.package.json:
{
  "name": "timegrass",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "packageManager": "yarn@4.18.0",
  "description": "Cumulo Workflow",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24"
  },
  "main": "index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "check-client": "calcit calcit.cirru --check-only && calcit calcit.cirru test --tag :client --require-match",
    "check-server": "calcit calcit.cirru --entry server --check-only && calcit calcit.cirru --entry server test --exclude-tag :js --require-match",
    "check-sync": "yarn check-client && yarn check-server && calcit calcit.cirru analyze weak-types --only deprecated-call",
    "check-dayjs-adapter": "node check-dayjs-adapter.mjs",
    "check-title-contract": "node check-title-contract.mjs",
    "check-session-messages": "node check-session-messages.mjs",
    "check-typed-database": "calcit calcit.cirru --entry server --emit-path .calcit/js-server js && node check-typed-database.mjs",
    "compile-page": "calcit calcit.cirru js",
    "dev-page": "vite --force",
    "release-page": "vite build --base=${VITE_BASE_URL:-./}",
    "watch-page": "calcit calcit.cirru -w js"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:TopixIM/timegrass.git"
  },
  "author": "jiyinyiyong",
  "license": "MIT",
  "dependencies": {
    "@calcit/procs": "0.31.0-alpha.2",
    "dayjs": "^1.11.23",
    "nanoid": "^6.0.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "bottom-tip": "^0.1.5",
    "copy-text-to-clipboard": "^3.2.2",
    "feather-icons": "^4.29.2",
    "url-parse": "^1.5.10",
    "vite": "^8.3.3"
  }
}
